Consolidate the audited319A growing-order collapse construction and321C linear-fraction rigidity theorem in one expanded manuscript. At the same critical moment budget, exact uniform weighting-law marginals through every fixed power L^alpha with alpha<1/2 allow collapse, while every fixed positive linear fraction forces operator-norm convergence to unweighted noise. The latter conclusion explicitly uses Kirshner--Samorodnitsky Theorem1.3/Proposition2.7. Critical-power uniform integrability and a strict-exponent estimate are grouped as complementary sufficient conditions; no sublinear transition is claimed.

Retain complete source reports and context, declared private-index exclusions, and the historical exact v7 PDF/report with all five reservations. Repair the v7 page22 equation reference symbolically. Historical scores do not rate322. No new PDF, paired build, visual inspection, exact-PDF assessment, historical priority, independent review, physical gap or formal proof is claimed. Frozen document/source audit and required CI precede integration; Colab production and a new exact-PDF assessment follow separately.
